label: shoulder press - no obvious issue
labels_descriptive: shoulder press - No obvious form issue is indicated by the source label
feedback_en: Keep following the reference movement and arm path.

label: shoulder press - arms too wide at the top
labels_descriptive: shoulder press - User's arms spread too far outward at the top compared with the reference press
name_en: arms too wide at the top
feedback_en: Keep your arms from spreading outward at the top; follow the reference arm path.
feedback_ko: 올릴 때 양팔이 바깥으로 퍼지지 않도록 기준 영상의 궤적에 맞춰주세요.

label: shoulder press - incomplete upward range
labels_descriptive: shoulder press - User lowers the weights before reaching the upward range shown in the reference press
feedback_en: Reach the upward position shown in the reference before lowering your arms.
feedback_ko: 기준 영상처럼 팔을 충분히 올린 뒤 내려주세요.

label: shoulder press - hands move behind the head
labels_descriptive: shoulder press - User's hands move behind the head while the elbows remain high during lowering
name_ko: 하강 시 손이 머리 뒤로 이동
feedback_en: Follow the reference press path from beside your shoulders rather than folding the weights behind your head.
feedback_ko: 기준 프레스 동작처럼 어깨 옆에서 위로 밀어주세요.

label: shoulder press - forearms tilt inward
labels_descriptive: shoulder press - User's wrists move inward relative to the elbows during lowering
feedback_en: Avoid moving only your hands inward as you lower; match wrist and elbow alignment to the reference.
feedback_ko: 내릴 때 손만 안쪽으로 모으지 말고 손목과 팔꿈치의 정렬을 기준 영상에 맞춰주세요.

label: shoulder press - elbow path narrower than reference
labels_descriptive: shoulder press - User's elbows move closer to the torso at the bottom than in the reference press variation
feedback_en: If following this reference press variation, adjust your elbow spacing slightly wider to match the reference.
feedback_ko: 기준 프레스 동작을 따르는 경우 팔꿈치 간격을 기준 영상에 맞춰 조금 넓혀주세요.

label: shoulder press - uneven arm height and timing
labels_descriptive: shoulder press - User's arms reach different heights and move at different times during the simultaneous press
feedback_en: Raise both arms together at matching heights and speeds for this simultaneous press variation.
feedback_ko: 양팔을 같은 높이와 속도로 함께 올려주세요.
